diagnosis.what_happened: Agents omitted a comprehensive Chapter 4 introduction/summary, left raw English words in Persian text, and used verbose Persian translations instead of APA statistical symbols in table headers.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Writing fragmented or incomplete chapter structures and cluttering table headers with verbose Persian translations compromised the formal academic register and APA standards.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Chapter 4 must strictly include a comprehensive introduction and summary. Table explanations must be rewritten in smooth, scholarly, continuous academic tone. Zero raw English words in Persian text/tables. Table headers must use standard APA statistical symbols (e.g., M, SD, F, p) with Persian definitions in table notes.
diagnosis.rationale_why: APA 7 and institutional thesis formatting require concise table headers using universal statistical symbols and pure Persian narrative flow devoid of raw Latin text.

desired_behavior: Use standard APA statistical symbols (M, SD, SE, F, t, p, R, R², B, β, OR, χ², df, SS, MS, DW, VIF, Tol) in table header cells; provide Persian definitions in table notes; enforce zero raw English words in Persian body text; include comprehensive introduction at chapter start and comprehensive summary at chapter end.
generalization: All Persian thesis chapters must start/end with comprehensive introductions/summaries, maintain 100% pure Persian prose (no English words), and strictly use APA Latin symbols for table headers with accompanying note definitions.

evidence.observed_value: Verbose Persian table headers, missing intro/summary, raw English words in text.
evidence.threshold_value: APA symbols in headers, explicit intro/summary, pure Persian text.
